scoping_decision.question: Do gates 2 and 5 scope to the release candidate set or to every UC in the graph?
scoping_decision.reasoning: PR #6 changes only worker/src/llm/kieai.ts. UC-004 is not re-delivered by it, and the PR explicitly documents that this retry policy is inert on the UC-004 path (F-004). Gate text scopes to "every UC where the matrix marks PROD_GOLDEN_PATH mandatory" in what is being released.
scoping_decision.counter_argument: A graph-wide reading would block every future release until the UC-004 QA debt clears. That is the more conservative reading and was NOT taken.
scoping_decision.not_hidden: The UC-004 debt is recorded under outstanding_debt below and in the GitHub release notes.
